jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Graphics Engineer, AI for Experiences
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is searching for a world-class engineer in graphics and AI to join our neural graphics product team. If you agree with us that the most exciting thing about the AI revolution is applying it to solve real problems, this team will be an excellent fit for you! We are passionate about applications in generative AI, gaming, augmented reality, user-generated content, computer vision, and other areas, with the goal of improving visual fidelity, gameplay, or other domains within the gaming and pro-visualization markets. Working with other teams throughout the company, you will productize promising research, as well as develop new features through your own work.

What You'll Be Doing

Use AI for solving product problems in gaming and other interactive experiences.
Build upon the latest research to create new models and invent new ways of applying AI to advance neural graphics and gaming.
Create prototypes to demonstrate real-life applications of your ideas and to accelerate productization.
Keep up with the latest AI/DL research and collaborate with diverse teams (both internal and external to NVIDIA), including AI/DL researchers, hardware architects, and software engineers.
Participate in technology transfers to and from teams across NVIDIA.

What We Need To See

Master's in computer science/engineering, Machine Learning, AI, and related fields (or equivalent experience)
8+ years of machine learning / deep learning research or work experience
Knowledge of application areas such as real-time computer graphics, CV, and game development.
Expertise with programming systems such as Python, C+, CUDA, and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. Very strong programming skills.
A proven track record of delivering complex products and technologies spanning multiple teams and functional areas.

Intelligent machines powered by AI computers that can learn, reason, and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Image recognition and speech recognition — GPU deep learning has provided the foundation for machines to learn, perceive, reason, and solve problems. The GPU started out as the engine for simulating human imagination, conjuring up the amazing virtual worlds of video games and Hollywood films. Now, NVIDIA's GPU runs deep learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and acts as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and artificial intelligence come together in our architecture. Two modes of the human brain, two modes of the GPU. This may explain why NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for deep learning, and NVIDIA is known as “the AI computing company.”

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

183,750 USD – 351,000 USD for Level 4; and 225,000 USD – 429,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 20, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer, Human Physiology Modeling
jobs.description:
We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. We offer a competitive salary, an annual bonus based on company performance, healthcare and wellbeing programs, pension plan membership, and shares and savings programme. We embrace modern work practices; our Performance with Choice programme offers a remote or hybrid working model, empowering you to find the optimal balance between remote and in-office work.

Discover more about our company-wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage Life at GSK | GSK

Find out more about GSK and R&D: Our approach to R&D

Senior AI/ML Engineer, Human Physiology Modeling

GSK is building a computational capability that models human physiology as an interconnected, multiscale system. We are hiring the founding member of a new team. You will set the technical direction, build the first models and help define the team's practices.

You will also connect models across scales, from molecular and cellular to tissue, organ and whole-body level and turn that scope into a prioritized modeling roadmap, choosing the right method for each question. You will work with key stakeholders across GSK. The goal is models that inform real decisions, such as target hypotheses, mechanism of action, safety, biomarkers and patient stratification.

This is a hands-on role. You will write, review and ship production-quality scientific software, as well as set the scientific direction.

This is a hybrid role in the United States in San Francisco, CA or Cambridge, MA. You will be expected to work on-site regularly and collaborate with colleagues across sites and regions in the United States.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following
:

Define and own the modeling strategy and phased roadmap across the team's organ systems. Recommend sequencing based on scientific tractability, data availability and portfolio relevance.
Build, calibrate and validate multiscale models of physiological function, regulation and disease.
Define how models of different organ systems and scales interface and compose.
Integrate heterogeneous data into models: human genetics and genomics, single-cell and spatial omics, imaging, clinical and EHR data, and published physiology knowledge.
Establish standards for uncertainty quantification, sensitivity analysis, parameter identifiability and model validation.
Write reproducible, tested, version-controlled and containerized code that runs on GSK cloud and HPC infrastructure, in partnership with platform engineering.
Work with experimental colleagues to design studies that test or constrain model predictions.
Communicate results and their limits clearly to scientists and senior leaders.
Help hire, onboard and mentor future team members. Evangelize and enforce code-review, documentation and modeling standards set by the group.
Track the external literature and open-source ecosystem, and contribute or publish where appropriate.

Basic Qualifications:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

A minimum of a BS, MS, or PhD in computational or systems biology, biomedical engineering, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field.
A minimum of 4 years of experience with a PhD, a minimum of 5 years of experience with an MS and a minimum of 8 years of experience with a BS. All experience must involve building and applying quantitative models of biological or physiological systems, in academia or industry. For candidates without an advanced degree, a track record of published work, shipped models or open-source contributions can substitute for some of the required years.
A minimum of 2 years of experience modeling the physical and biological processes that recur across organ systems. These include fluid flow and transport, mass exchange across barriers and membranes, tissue mechanics, hormonal and neural regulation, and cell population dynamics.
A minimum of 4 years of experience with Advanced Python Programming. You can write robust, tested, maintainable scientific code using version control, CI/CD and containerization.
A minimum of 2 years of modeling human physiology.
A minimum of 2 years of taking models from concept to a result that changed a scientific or program decision.

Preferred Qualifications:

Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:

Experience with organ-level or whole-body modeling, including physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) and quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) models.
Familiarity with open-source simulation tools and standards (for example PhysiCell, COPASI, OpenCOR, FEniCS, SBML and CellML) and with HPC/GPU workflows.
Experience with differentiable simulation, physics-informed ML, learned world models or generative models of biological systems. Experience with LLM and agentic tooling for scientific workflows is also useful.
Experience with Kubernetes, workflow orchestration and MLOps on cloud or HPC.
Publications in computational biology, systems biology or ML venues, or open-source contributions.
Experience mentoring or technically leading small teams.

Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Model Validation, Predictive Modeling, Probabilistic Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation

If you are based in Cambridge, MA; Waltham, MA; Rockville, MD; or San Francisco, CA, the annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges $160,050 to $266,750. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees.

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

jobs.title: Founding AI Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
Base Comp:
 $220k - $520k

Total Comp:
 $360k up to $3.4M+ for exceptional performance (with major milestone bonuses up to $3.4M+ for achieving SOTA contact-rich manipulation and other SOTA robotics targets)

The Opportunity

Newtson Industries is hiring a Founding AI Robotics Engineer to work alongside Inventor & CEO Dylan Gastel, our Founding AI Researcher, and our Founding Robotics Hardware and Mechatronics Engineers to build and train the intelligence brain behind Newtson's robotics team. Our ambition is to build the best robot in the world, and our overarching technical goal is to achieve SOTA contact-rich dexterous manipulation across real-world physical tasks. As our first short-term proving target on the path to SOTA manipulation, we are sprinting to catch a high-speed football pass from an NFL quarterback better than any wide receiver and better than any other robot in the world before the Super Bowl. Newtson is in the business of inventing technologies that are #1 in the world. You will play a defining role in making history.

How We Operate

Newtson is building a team of S-tier individual contributors who operate as CEOs of their own internal startup, advancing their key initiative within the greater business. We are not seeking senior-level executives who wish to build a large org to manage. We are seeking the hungriest, highest-output individuals who believe their potential is at least 10 times higher than their current compensation structure allows for. If you are the type of person who feels like you can do the work of 10 of your peers, and you wish to be compensated accordingly, Newtson is the place for you. If you feel like you have something to prove, we don't care what it is — we will help you prove it.

Qualifications

Newtson Industries is seeking an individual with the following qualifications:

You are fired up to own building and training the brain behind the best robot in the world — with SOTA contact-rich manipulation as the main mission and our Super Bowl pass-catching milestone as the immediate proving ground.
You understand that your primary contribution is training and deploying real-time perception, prediction, and control policies that push physical robots past current SOTA manipulation limits.
You are a powerful sole contributor eager to collaborate, yet you understand that our success often hinges on your ability to put your head down and just Do Your Job.
You buckle in to grind when needed, and you appreciate that Newtson rewards high output over hard work.
You value the importance of working together, in person, and you will be a strong contributor to team camaraderie, collaboration, and creativity.
You are eager to join a company run like a professional sports team — contribute significantly and you will be significantly rewarded. Mediocrity does not win championships and will be replaced. You are here to win championships.
You bring proven industry experience OR raw, S-tier talent and execution speed across the required job functions — we pay for output, not years on a resume.
You will thrive at a company of Newtson's size — with approximately ten total employees and where you may be the only individual in your department.
You are fearless, yet you take a practical, data-driven approach to risk taking.
You are creative, yet you are comfortable executing repetitive or mundane tasks.
You dream big and frequently voice your ideas, yet you have the humility to know that your ideas will not always prevail.
You usually find the correct answer yourself, yet you have the self-awareness to know when to ask for help.
You are honest, genuine, and care about your individual success and performance, yet you will be selfless and will put the success of the greater entity before that of yourself, knowing that your teammates are doing the same.
You are confident that if chosen for this role, this will be your best career decision.
Your friends, family, and colleagues would overwhelmingly agree with the above statements.

About the Role

You own building, training, and deploying the brain behind Newtson's robots. Your primary goal is achieving SOTA contact-rich manipulation — mastering high-speed, force-sensitive physical interaction on real hardware and scaling those capabilities across American factory floors, with $3.4M+ upside directly tied to hitting SOTA contact-rich manipulation and subsequent SOTA robotics benchmarks. Catching 60 mph NFL passes before the Super Bowl is our short-term target designed to force ultra-low-latency perception, tactile feedback, and dynamic control under real impact loads. You take learning-based and optimal-control policies from simulation and proprietary factory datasets and run them deterministically on hardware under strict 50 to 200 ms budgets.

Required Skills

Robot Brain & SOTA Control

Train and deploy imitation learning, reinforcement learning, VLA, and optimal-control policies directly onto fast, contact-rich multi-axis robots.
Build ultra-low-latency 3D perception, tracking, state estimation, and trajectory prediction pipelines in C++ and Python.
Fuse high-frequency tactile arrays (2,500 Hz), joint encoders, and high-speed vision to solve contact-rich grasping, in-hand manipulation, and dynamic impacts.
Optimize on-robot model inference using CUDA, TensorRT, and C++ to hold hard real-time control loop budgets without jitter.

Work Style

Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO, Founding AI Researcher, Robotics Hardware and Mechatronics Engineers, and Test Quarterback beside the physical robot until reliability approaches 100%.
Own the full loop from simulation and policy training to real-robot deployment without throwing models over a wall.
Combine S-tier research taste for SOTA breakthroughs with pragmatic engineering speed for immediate hardware milestones.

Preferred

Shipped SOTA or near-SOTA real-world policies on dexterous hands, contact-rich manipulators, humanoids, or high-speed dynamic robots.
Deep proficiency in MuJoCo, Isaac Lab, PyTorch, high-speed multi-camera geometry, tactile learning, and real-time Linux.

How to Apply

Send your resume, Google Scholar or GitHub, and 2 to 3 videos of policies or control stacks you personally trained and deployed on real physical robot hardware — along with what broke during sim-to-real transfer and how you solved it.

Email your application to careers@newtson.com.

Newtson Industries is headquartered in San Francisco at the heart of Union St in Cow Hollow. This is an in-person role.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer | AI Security & Fraud Detection

Location:
San Francisco, CA - Onsite
Compensation:
$220,000–$300,000
Experience:
3+ Years, Ideally 5+ Years
Industry:
AI Infrastructure, Agentic AI, Cybersecurity, Fraud Prevention

About the Opportunity

Shields Group Search is partnering with a well-funded, early-stage AI infrastructure startup building the trust and security layer for the rapidly emerging AI agent economy.
As AI agents increasingly act autonomously on behalf of individuals and businesses, from booking services and accessing APIs to executing financial transactions, companies need infrastructure that can determine which agents are legitimate, who they represent, what actions they're authorized to perform, and whether their behavior presents a security or fraud risk.
Our client is building real-time verification and decisioning infrastructure that enables businesses to safely interact with AI agents at scale.
The platform combines agent identity verification, behavioral intelligence, risk assessment, and security controls to distinguish legitimate automated activity from suspicious or malicious behavior.

We're looking for an exceptional Machine Learning Engineer to build the models that distinguish a trusted AI agent from an attack, in real time and under load.

This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical founding-stage engineering team and take meaningful ownership of mission-critical ML infrastructure.
What You'll Be Working On
The models behind this platform operate directly on the production request path. They must evaluate activity and support trust decisions in real time, under the same strict latency constraints as the rest of the infrastructure.
There is no offline batch job to hide behind and no second chance if a prediction is too slow or incorrect.

You'll work on problems involving:

Real-Time Fraud & Threat Detection:
Develop ML models that identify potentially fraudulent, malicious, or unauthorized agent activity while minimizing false positives.
Behavioral & Anomaly Detection:
Identify suspicious patterns, anomalous agent interactions, and emerging risks across automated transactions and API activity.
Low-Latency ML Inference:
Build and optimize production model-serving systems capable of making accurate decisions under demanding latency and throughput requirements.
Cold-Start & Low-Label Learning:
Develop effective detection approaches when labeled examples are scarce, including unsupervised learning, weak supervision, and custom evaluation datasets.
End-to-End ML Ownership:
Build, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production ML systems, from data and feature pipelines through real-time serving.
Adversarial ML:
Help build systems that remain effective as malicious actors adapt their behavior to evade detection.
Agentic AI Infrastructure:
Work at the intersection of modern ML, AI agents, tool calling, identity verification, and security.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

3+ years of professional ML experience
, ideally 5+ years, building, evaluating, and deploying production models, not just research or notebooks.
Strong Python and a modern ML framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow); solid SQL.
Production ML systems end to end: feature pipelines, training, evaluation, and low-latency, real-time serving.
Comfort with low-label and cold-start problems, including anomaly detection, unsupervised methods, weak supervision, and building evaluation sets and labels from scratch.
Data analysis, statistics, and experiment design.
Strong software engineering. You ship versioned, testable, reproducible code, not throwaway models.
Experience working in highly technical engineering environments with strong software engineering standards.
Ability to take ownership, solve ambiguous problems, and ship production-grade solutions in a fast-moving startup environment.

Strongly Preferred

Applied ML in fraud, risk, abuse, account integrity, or security.
Experience building ML models for fraud prevention, threat detection, trust and safety, or other systems designed to prevent malicious activity.
Graph ML / GNNs, sequence or behavioral modeling, or anomaly detection.
LLM / NLP work, and familiarity with AI agents, including tool use, function calling, and MCP.
Experience in adversarial settings, where the threat evolves against the model.
Explainable, auditable, reproducible ML, with real model versioning.
Experience developing ML systems at highly technical, engineering-driven companies, particularly those working on large-scale infrastructure, payments, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or AI platforms.

Bonus Qualifications

Payment protocols (x402), agent identity (DID / VC), or crypto commitments (Merkle anchoring).
Experience at an early-stage startup or building ML infrastructure from the ground up.
Familiarity with real-time transaction monitoring, behavioral risk scoring, or identity verification systems.

Compensation & Work Arrangement

Base Salary:
$220,000–$300,000
Equity:
Competitive equity participation in an early-stage, venture-backed company.
Location:
San Francisco, CA.
Work Arrangement:
The team strongly prefers engineers working onsite five days per week. Hybrid flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates who can regularly collaborate in person.
Start Date:
The team is hiring immediately and can move quickly for the right individual.

jobs.title: Applied Research Scientist, Manufacturing
jobs.description:
About Lumafield: 

Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing.

We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.

Engineers make million-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non-destructively.

We rebuilt the whole system, from X-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again.

Lumafield is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. and has an office in Cambridge, MA. 

About the role: 

Lumafield has the world’s largest dataset of real manufactured products. Encoded into this dataset are deep representations of design and manufacturing rules.  Automating manufacturing is a key pillar in Lumafield’s ultimate vision to transform all of design and manufacturing.  

As an Applied Research Scientist, Manufacturing, you will lead technical development of our manufacturing automation capabilities.  This is a uniquely applied role:  you will wear steel toed boots while writing code in manufacturing facilities.  

What you'll do:

Lead technical development of methods to automate manufacturing processes like die casting, injection molding, CNC machining, and more.

Design experiments, implement them, and iterate until you have a manufacturing process autonomous. 

Integrate robots, manufacturing equipment, and CT scanners in our SF manufacturing lab

Interface with customers to define pilot programs. 

Travel to customer manufacturing sites all around the world. 

About you:

Are excellent at prototyping and 0-1 problems. 

Have applied machine learning and optimization experience. 

Have strong instincts for experiment design and are deeply empirical. 

Are AI native and can apply the tools with high leverage. 

Are well-versed in scientific computing and simulation packages.

Are extremely independent and can give unstructured problems structure and direction. 

5-10 years of experience in a relevant technical field. 

Bonus:

Advanced degree in machine learning, optimization, or a relevant discipline.

Background or experience in design, manufacturing, or physical hardware.

Familiarity with BREP/analytical geometry or CAD kernels.

PLC programming experience. 

A portfolio of work that you can share that is relevant to this role. 

Lumafield offers both competitive cash and equity compensation, as well as a health & wellness stipend, 401k, parental leave, flexible PTO, commuter benefits, company wide events and more!

jobs.description:
We are:

A leading partner to the world’s major cloud providers, including AWS, Azure, and Google. The formation of Accenture Cloud First, with a $3 billion investment over three years, demonstrates our commitment to deliver greater value to our clients when they need it most and offers huge growth opportunities for you! Our Cloud First group of more than 70,000 cloud professionals delivers a full stack of integrated cloud capabilities across data, edge, integrated infrastructure and applications, deep ecosystem skills, culture of change along with a deep industry expertise to shape, move, build and operate our clients’ businesses in the cloud. To accelerate our customers transformation leveraging cloud, we combine world-class learning and talent development expertise; deep experience in cloud change management; and cloud-ready operating models with a commitment to responsible business by design — with security, data privacy, responsible use of artificial intelligence, sustainability and ethics and compliance built into the fundamental changes Accenture helps companies achieve.

About the Role: Building the Future in the Age of Agents

Join the elite technical and product engine of the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG). We are not a traditional project delivery organization; we are a practice of innovators and builders guiding our clients through the most significant shift in technology: the move to Agentic AI and Product-Led Operating Models. As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Agentic AI Delivery Engineer, you are a new breed of technologist—a "product-minded engineer" who is as fluent in the language of code as you are in the language of customer outcomes. You don't just build solutions; you leverage the best of technologies Google Cloud has to offer for client requirements, helping clients break free from legacy solution mindset and practices to build truly modern, value-driven software products on Google Cloud.

You Are:

A passionate, hands-on GCP specialist/practitioner who understands that great software is not just about elegant code, but about solving real problems leveraging the best technology tools available for a client. You are as comfortable building a multi-agent workflow on Vertex AI as you are testing a solution built by other team members in a compressed timeline, leveraging the various tools and technologies of Google Cloud. You have a consultative mindset and a deep curiosity to understand the "why" behind a client's business requirements and convert them to an optimal technology solution. You are an evangelist for modern ways of working, grounded in the principles of Product-Led engineering and operating models and related approaches. You are an exceptional communicator, great team player, continuous learner and a true believer in continual change.

The Work:

As a GCP Agentic AI Delivery Engineer, you will be a technical and product-centric engineer in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud Agentic solutions for client requirements. You will partner with Accenture's global delivery teams by providing superior technical expertise and product innovation skills. Your role is to execute complex technology solutions for our clients by designing, building, and demonstrating Agentic AI solutions. You will act as a trusted team player, guiding others in the team on how to adopt a Product Engineering mindset and be the expert on specific Google Cloud technologies/products.

Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. Design, build, test and deploy innovative, agentic-first solutions on GCP that are directly tied to the client business requirements.

Hands-On Development & Proof-of-Value: Rapidly design, build, and present compelling proof-of-concept (POC) solutions that bring your Google Cloud proficiency to workable solutions. This includes hands-on software engineering using Vertex AI, Gemini/Agentic AI, BigQuery, Google Data technologies, Terraform, and modern CI/CD practices.

Product-Led Project delivery: Act as an agile SME/coach on modern software development. Guide and enable the delivery team on the principles of the Product Agile Operating Model and how to structure delivery sprints for continuous delivery using Google Cloud Technologies.

Team Collaboration: Ability to travel as needed for project meetings, workshops, client discussions, etc., Working with global teams and leveraging the various collaborative tools and channels for project delivery and status reporting.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).

Minimum of 3 years of experience in a hands-on, client-facing technology role (e.g., Google Cloud Engineer, Product Engineer, Technology Consultant).

Minimum of 3 years of deep, hands-on experience architecting and building solutions on GCP.

Minimum of 2 years of experience interacting with project team members distributed across the globe. Well versed in project management methodologies and product/project testing methodologies.

Minimum of 2 years of proven experience on Google Cloud technologies OR Minimum of 1 years of implementation experience on EITHER Agentic systems, leveraging Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Azure Foundry, Microsoft Co-Pilot and/or AWS Bedrock OR on Agentic systems and Google Gemini Enterprise Partner Specialist certifications (CPS)

Bonus points if you have

Product & Agile Mindset: Hands-on experience working within a Product Operating Model. Practical experience in delivering agile projects, contributing to sprint-based deliverables and outcomes.

Consulting & Innovation Acumen: Experience participating in client-facing innovation workshops and converting ideas into outcome-focused solutions. World-class communication skills to articulate project status and delivery challenges and issues to project leadership and client audiences.

Agentic AI & Software Product Engineering: Proven experience architecting and building agentic workflows using Vertex AI. Deep understanding of agentic components, including reasoning engines, planning, tool use, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Hands-on expertise with Google's Gemini models. A commitment to software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and building secure, scalable products.

Technical Depth: Google Cloud Professional certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Data Engineer, GenAI Leader). Project experience across the GCP ecosystem, including GKE, BigQuery, Vertex AI, CES, Apigee, and other GCP technologies.

jobs.title: Senior Deep Learning Scientist, AI Safety
jobs.description:
NVIDIA played a key role in launching the modern AI era with GPU-accelerated deep learning. Today, generative AI opens outstanding opportunities—helping people share ideas, gain knowledge, and solve problems once out of reach. Making that promise trustworthy is one of the major scientific challenges today. As a Deep Learning Scientist in AI Safety, you will advance research in model alignment, create methods to reduce harmful behaviors, and transform new insights into practical protections for large language models. Join us to develop how advanced AI interacts with people and help extend its benefits worldwide.

NVIDIA is recruiting Senior Deep Learning Scientists to push forward our work in multimodal AI safety, covering Product Security, Content Safety, Bias, and Human-AI Interactions. You will bring core expertise in deep learning to reinforce models for safe reasoning, planning, and acting across different modalities. This opportunity enables you to contribute essential algorithmic advances for foundational models processing diverse data formats. Your initiatives will reach scale via Nemotron Omni platforms, guardrails, and partnerships outside the organization. You will focus on high-impact, prominent safety challenges of large language models and multimodal AI products that improve user experiences for millions. If you are imaginative and driven to tackle real-world agentic AI safety issues, join our team.

What You Will Be Doing

Apply fundamental and applied safety research to develop, train, fine-tune, and deploy large language architectures supporting multimodal agentic reasoning systems and guardrails encompassing text, audio, image, video, and tool usage.
Advance post-training and alignment methods including instruction tuning, preference optimization, and RLHF/RLVR/MOPD to improve safety of multimodal agents for complex use cases.
Research and advance the latest trends in AI safety as applied to pre-/mid-/post-training, guardrails, and steering techniques.
Lead the collection, development, and benchmarking of multimodal safety datasets, ensuring high-quality evaluation of model accuracy, safety, and task completion success.

What We Need To See

Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or Applied Math with 8+ years of relevant work experience.
Excellent programming skills in Python with strong fundamentals in scalable model development and deep learning frameworks like PyTorch.
Strong knowledge of ML/DL techniques and modern foundation model architectures, including Transformers and mixture-of-experts models.
Hands-on experience in post-training multimodal models for multimodal reasoning.
Proven ability to manage model development life cycles, including dataset versioning, experiment tracking, and evaluation pipelines.
Responsible AI Expertise: 1+ years of experience in content safety, ML fairness, AI model security, human-AI interaction, or related areas.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Strong record of publications in top-tier AI and machine learning venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, FAccT, or CVPR.
Experience applying deep reinforcement learning techniques to train multimodal agents in complex simulation.
Safety and Compliance: Proven experience addressing safety and legal and regulatory compliance in multimodal, multilingual, or multi-turn systems.
Multi-turn Safety Evaluation: dynamic and multi-turn alignment benchmarks.
Experience in at least one of the following risk areas: CBRNE, persuasion and manipulation (influence operations, disinformation, and the erosion of democratic values through AI-generated content), discrimination at scale enabled by AI systems, mental health (sycophancy and manipulation), LLM security (backdoors, data poisoning, latent malicious behavior, structural model vulnerabilities), frontier risks (model deception, manipulation, and loss-of-control scenarios), agentic safety (tool-calling, orchestration, and execution), multi-turn.

About The Team

At GET (Growth Experience Technology), we fuel sustainable growth by rethinking how customers discover, buy, and use Autodesk. Our focus is creating a seamless, data-driven experience that feels simple, predictable, and tailored to customer needs—while also making it easier and more efficient for our teams to support them. 

To get there, we're building smarter digital experiences, strengthening our platforms, and making our sales and marketing efforts much more efficient and connected. While the product experience will play a key role, a real unlock will come from the technologies that power better customer insights, more personalized engagement, and faster sales cycles. 

What you’ll do

The GET Applied AI organization is looking for a seasoned Senior Manager / Senior Principal of Applied AI Engineering
to lead the application of AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics across Autodesk’s B2C business. This role will play a critical leadership role in shaping how Autodesk uses data and AI to build the eCommerce and personalization platforms of the future.

Applied AI Engineers at Autodesk are both data/research scientists and software engineers, who develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms. Unlike other companies that separate these roles, our Applied AI Engineers work on projects from ideation to implementation.

As a Sr. Principal Applied AI Engineer at Autodesk, you will be responsible for the development and training of cutting-edge machine learning models and algorithms that can effectively leverage our users’ platform activities and industry trends to create personalized recommendations that are delivered to our users at the optimal moment.

As a senior leader within Applied AI, you will set technical and strategic direction, lead a portfolio of high-impact AI/ML initiatives, develop talent, and partner with senior business and technology leaders
to translate Autodesk’s business priorities into scalable AI capabilities.

You will be responsible for advancing machine learning solutions that leverage customer behavior, product engagement, commerce signals, and industry trends to create more relevant and personalized customer experiences. You will also help establish the organizational practices, technical standards, and operating mechanisms needed to scale Applied AI across Autodesk.

Responsibilities

Set the Applied AI Strategy – Define and drive the vision, roadmap, and investment priorities for key data science and machine learning capabilities across Autodesk’s B2C business, including personalization, recommendation systems, segmentation, forecasting, experimentation, churn prediction, product analytics, and customer insights.
Lead a Portfolio of High-Impact Initiatives – Own multiple complex, cross-functional AI/ML programs from strategy through production and business adoption. Establish clear priorities, success metrics, operating rhythms, and accountability to ensure the team delivers measurable customer and business outcomes.
Build and Develop a High-Performing Team – Provide leadership, coaching, and career development for Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers. Create an environment that attracts strong technical talent, raises the bar for execution, and enables individuals to grow in both technical depth and leadership.
Provide Technical Leadership – Establish technical direction and engineering standards for machine learning systems, model development, experimentation, evaluation, production deployment, and MLOps. Guide teams through complex technical decisions while ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Autodesk’s broader technology architecture.
Expand Autodesk’s ML Capabilities – Identify emerging opportunities where AI and machine learning can materially improve the customer experience or business performance. Guide the design and development of scalable end-to-end ML platforms and pipelines that enable personalization and intelligent decision-making at scale.
Drive Experimentation at Scale – Establish robust experimentation and measurement practices that increase development velocity while maintaining scientific rigor. Enable teams to rapidly test hypotheses, evaluate model performance, quantify incremental impact, and translate learnings into product and business decisions.
Influence Senior Leadership – Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, and other functions. Frame ambiguous business problems, identify opportunities where AI can create value, recommend investment priorities, and influence strategic decisions through data.
Drive Cross-Functional Execution – Initiate and lead large-scale, complex strategic initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations. Build alignment across technical and business stakeholders, resolve ambiguity and competing priorities, and drive programs through execution and adoption.
Champion a Data- and AI-Driven Culture – Evangelize best practices in applied AI, machine learning, experimentation, and evidence-based decision-making. Help shape Autodesk’s broader approach to responsible, scalable, and business-oriented use of AI.
Translate Technology into Business Impact – Develop compelling narratives that connect data, model performance, customer behavior, and financial outcomes. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences and ensure AI investments are tied to measurable impact.
Raise the Organizational Bar – Establish reusable frameworks, processes, and best practices that improve how Applied AI teams prioritize work, evaluate opportunities, design solutions, and measure results. Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across Data Science, ML Engineering, and adjacent technical organizations.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another related quantitative or technical field.
10+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Research, or a related technical discipline, with significant experience delivering production-scale machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated experience leading teams, technical organizations, or major cross-functional programs, including setting strategy, establishing priorities, and driving execution across multiple simultaneous initiatives.
Experience developing technical talent through coaching, mentorship, technical leadership, performance management, or people management.
Proven ability to lead technical strategy, machine learning system design, and optimization of production-scale ML infrastructure, including model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, monitoring, debugging, and model optimization.
7+ years of experience with software or machine learning system design and architecture, including launching and operating production systems.
Deep hands-on experience with machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, recommendation or personalization systems, and applied statistical methods.
Strong expertise in A/B testing, experimental design, causal reasoning, and measurement.
Strong understanding of statistics, probability, customer and product analytics, and financial or business modeling.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into data and AI strategies and connect technical investments to measurable customer and business impact.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior technical and business leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

MS or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
15+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, or related disciplines, ideally including experience in eCommerce, personalization, growth, digital products, or consumer-facing platforms.
5+ years of experience in technical or people leadership, including building and developing high-performing Data Science and/or Machine Learning Engineering teams.
Experience defining multi-year AI/ML strategies and translating them into organizational roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience hiring, developing, and retaining senior Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and technical leaders.
Experience operating effectively in a matrixed environment and influencing senior executives across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and business organizations.
Hands-on experience with cloud machine learning platforms such as AWS or Azure and strong knowledge of modern MLOps, model governance, observability, and production ML best practices.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, ranking, forecasting, customer lifecycle, or next-best-action systems at significant scale.

jobs.title: AI Researcher (Remote)
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 01/24/2027

This position is hybrid in the Bay Area, New York City, or Seattle, WA. Fully remote candidates within the USA will also be considered.

Meet the Tea m

The Splunk Agent Resilience team is defining the future of AI resilience. Our team provides scalable, cost-effective evaluation and guardrails that ensure AI agents behave as intended, improving reliability and reducing risks. This unified approach empowers our customers to confidently deploy and manage AI-powered applications with enhanced observability and control.

Your Impact

You will independently own applied research problems that help organizations understand, evaluate, and improve AI agents across complete workflows. Your work will span agent evaluation, behavioral failure discovery, agent understanding, simulation, and optimization. You will develop novel algorithms and research methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and build generalizable AI solutions that balance quality, latency, and cost. You will construct datasets and benchmarks, incorporate human judgment, and validate ideas through controlled experiments, strong baselines, ablations, and systematic error analysis. Working with researchers, Product, Engineering, and customers, you will take an important research problem from hypothesis to a reproducible result and a useful product capability.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Independently lead applied research workstreams, from hypothesis development and dataset preparation through model training, evaluation, and implementation.
Train and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA, and other post-training techniques.
Develop and curate large-scale training datasets using real-world data, simulation, and synthetic data generation, including establishing labeling guidelines, analyzing annotation disagreements, and validating data quality.
Research and implement improvements to training objectives, data mixtures, sampling strategies, and model adaptation methods, including applying approaches from research literature and developing new methods.
Design and execute controlled experiments, baseline comparisons, and ablation studies to evaluate model performance, robustness, generalization, and failure modes.
Develop reproducible model training and evaluation pipelines, documenting methodologies and findings to support continued research and product development.
Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to evaluate model behavior, address deployment constraints, and integrate validated research methods into production workflows.
Communicate technical findings through research code, experimental reports, model documentation, and discussions with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Collaborate with global teams and customers, including occasional meetings outside standard local business hours to accommodate different time zones.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related field with 8+ years of related experience, or a Master's degree with 6+ years of related experience, or a PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
Experience applying machine learning or AI research to deployed products or practical business problems, including independently leading research workstreams from problem definition through experimentation, evaluation, and implementation.
Experience training and fine-tuning encoder or decoder transformer models using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA.
Experience developing machine learning solutions using Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent, including model training, optimization, and evaluation.
Experience developing and evaluating machine learning datasets, including data sourcing, curation, labeling, synthetic or simulation-based data generation, and experimental validation.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
Experience designing and executing controlled experiments, including baseline comparisons, ablation studies, leakage prevention, statistical analysis, and systematic error analysis.
Contributions to novel modeling, training, evaluation, or data generation methods demonstrated through research publications, open-source implementations, or documented experimental results.
Experience with advanced model training techniques, including preference optimization, contrastive learning, multi-task learning, or other approaches beyond supervised fine-tuning.
Experience developing simulation and synthetic data pipelines, optimizing data diversity and difficulty, or improving annotation consistency and label quality.
Experience with distributed model training, efficient processing of large datasets, or optimization of model training and inference performance.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Newtson Industries is hiring a Founding AI Researcher to work alongside Inventor & CEO Dylan Gastel, our Founding AI Robotics Engineer, our Founding Quantitative Researcher, and our Founding Software Engineers, training frontier physical intelligence models on the world's richest proprietary stream of U.S. manufacturing egocentric video, operational telemetry, and high-frequency tactile data. You are fired up by the prospect of achieving SOTA contact-rich dexterous manipulation while helping sequence the complete physical and operational genome of the entire U.S. economy.

Your friends, family, and colleagues would overwhelmingly agree with the above statements.

About the Role

Most AI researchers fight over the same public datasets; at Newtson, you bring S-tier research intuition to a proprietary 50-state industrial data engine capturing how America actually builds things. jobs.title: Research Scientist, NeuroAI
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high-risk, high-reward science in a well-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera's Open Science Policy.

Position Summary

Research Scientists in NeuroAI at Astera Neuro develop and lead research programs aimed at understanding how the brain builds a model of the physical world, forms new thoughts, and creates a stable model of the self. The goal is enough understanding and technical ability to precisely and reversibly modulate each of these functions through write-in experiments.

You will bring modern AI and machine learning methods to large-scale neural and behavioral recordings from our primate, rodent, and human programs. Working closely with experimental neuroscientists and engineers, you will build models that uncover how neural circuits in artificial and biological networks represent information and compute, and use those models to guide closed-loop experiments and targeted neural perturbations. This role suits researchers whose primary training is in machine learning; prior neuroscience experience is welcome but not required. Title and scope are calibrated to track record.

What You’ll Do

Develop and lead a machine learning research program to understand how the brain builds an internal model of the world, composes structured thoughts, and guides flexible behavior.
Train foundation models that align neural activity with sensory inputs and behavior across recording sessions, subjects, and species, enabling in silico experiments and closed-loop control of neural activity.
Develop mechanistic interpretability and representation analysis methods to uncover how artificial and biological networks compute, and analyze how neural geometry evolves over time and across task contexts.
Collaborate with experimental neuroscientists to test model predictions in vivo, designing behavioral tasks and closed-loop write-in perturbations that steer neural activity to alter percepts, thoughts, or internal states.
Translate computational principles discovered in the brain into new AI architectures and learning algorithms.
Mentor research engineers and, at the senior or principal level, more junior scientists; contribute to hiring, onboarding, and lab culture.
Contribute to publications, talks, open data and tooling releases, and engagement with the broader scientific community.

Who You Are

Required:

PhD with 3-12+ years of experience in machine learning, computer science, computational neuroscience, physics, applied mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent research experience.
Demonstrated ability to lead original machine learning research end to end, with depth in areas such as mechanistic interpretability, representation learning, reinforcement learning, world models, or foundation models.
Strong programming and research engineering skills in Python and PyTorch or JAX, with experience building custom architectures, learning objectives, or interpretability tools at scale.
Ability to collaborate closely with neuroscientists and engineers in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment.

Preferred/Nice to Have:

Experience in neuroscience, especially collaborating closely with experimentalists, analyzing large-scale neural and behavioral recordings, or conducting experimental work.
Experience connecting the internal computations of artificial networks to biological circuits, or designing model-guided, closed-loop neural perturbation experiments.
Experience scaling training and data pipelines across large, heterogeneous datasets, and contributing to ML or scientific tooling.

What We Value

Deep interest in understanding intelligence in biological and artificial systems.
Conviction that the brain’s internal model can be understood in full, and recognition that getting there requires a kind of science no single academic lab can do.
Willingness to be held to an engineering standard: our decisive tests are write-in experiments, not merely decoding. What we cannot build, we do not understand.
Comfort building on shared infrastructure rather than private projects.
Commitment to open science, including releasing code, models, and data publicly.

Additionally Expected At Senior / Principal Level

Experience setting research direction and leading collaborative projects across disciplines.
Track record of mentorship and technical leadership.

Why Join Us

Join Astera Neuro to work on the hardest and least understood questions in neuroscience: how the brain generates thoughts, intelligence, and consciousness. You will bring machine learning into close contact with large-scale neural experiments, building models that explain biological computation and using discoveries about the brain to inform new approaches to AI.

Astera Neuro provides a comprehensive benefits package and total compensation that is competitive and commensurate with the level of experience and qualifications.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion!

Compensation Range: $150K - $350K

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Beneficial Deployments

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

About The Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and foundations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment. You'll help partners find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations, design solutions that fit their budgets, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something the whole sector can use.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofit partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success.
Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation.
Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code across program delivery, fundraising, operations and data analysis.
Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement.
Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams.
Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next.
Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed.
Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have

3+ years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting.
A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow-moving teams to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it.
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code.
Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, operations staff and executives.
Patience with long buying cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit.
A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in.
Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.
Bonus if you've worked in a sales team, or with or at nonprofits, foundations or other mission-driven organizations.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$240,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. As a Technical Content Developer, Data Science, you’ll take design requirements and learning objectives from the curriculum roadmap and partner with subject matter experts to build course modules, hands-on labs, projects, and assessments. You’ll own the technical accuracy and instructional quality of what you produce so that learners can demonstrably apply new data science skills on the job.

Develop technical learning experiences (courses, modules, hands-on labs, projects, quizzes, and assessments) against defined design requirements and learning objectives for the data science domain.

Author and test hands-on labs, notebooks, and projects end to end, making sure datasets and coding environments are configured correctly and working solutions are reproducible by every learner.

Build assessments, quizzes, and other instructional-design elements that measure whether the target skill was actually acquired, in line with LearnVantage learning standards.

Validate the technical accuracy of all content, partnering with subject matter experts and authors to keep pace with changes in data science libraries, platforms, and industry practice.

You’ll build data science learning that reaches people at enterprise scale and gives them skills they can apply on the job.

You’ll work at the leading edge of AI-accelerated content development, helping shape the tooling and workflows the pipeline depends on.

Accenture will continually invest in your craft and growth, with access to certifications, learning resources, and a global community of practitioners.

You’ll collaborate with subject matter experts, authors, and testers across the Accenture LearnVantage team.

Minimum 3 years of experience in instructional design, curriculum development, or teaching technical content to adult learners, grounded in adult learning science (scaffolding, retrieval practice, cognitive load, and assessment).

We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

We Are:

Accenture LearnVantage helps organizations transform how their people learn and work. We partner with enterprise clients to design and deliver high-quality, scalable, outcome-driven learning that builds the skills their workforces need. Udacity, now part of Accenture LearnVantage, brings deep expertise in technical upskilling through hands-on, project-based online learning. Together we build learning experiences that help people gain in-demand skills in data science, machine learning, AI, and more.

You Are:

You are a technical learning content developer who turns data science expertise into learning experiences that stick. You combine hands-on work in Python, statistics, and machine learning with a grounding in how adults learn, and you judge your own content by whether learners can demonstrably apply the skill in a real-world setting. You own the technical accuracy and instructional quality of what you build, you use AI tooling to work faster without dropping the quality bar, and you collaborate well with subject matter experts, authors, and testers. You are the first person through your own material, so you find the gaps a learner would hit before a learner does. You move toward solutions even when requirements are ambiguous, guided by data but biased toward action.

The Work:

Join the Learning Experience team and help build the data science learning experiences that power effective workforce upskilling at enterprise scale. As a Technical Content Developer, Data Science, you’ll take design requirements and learning objectives from the curriculum roadmap and partner with subject matter experts to build course modules, hands-on labs, projects, and assessments. You’ll own the technical accuracy and instructional quality of what you produce so that learners can demonstrably apply new data science skills on the job.

Develop technical learning experiences (courses, modules, hands-on labs, projects, quizzes, and assessments) against defined design requirements and learning objectives for the data science domain.

Author and test hands-on labs, notebooks, and projects end to end, making sure datasets and coding environments are configured correctly and working solutions are reproducible by every learner.

Build assessments, quizzes, and other instructional-design elements that measure whether the target skill was actually acquired, in line with LearnVantage learning standards.

Validate the technical accuracy of all content, partnering with subject matter experts and authors to keep pace with changes in data science libraries, platforms, and industry practice.

Coach new authors through the course development process and give pedagogical feedback on their content from the learner’s perspective.

Use AI tooling to accelerate drafting, iteration, and QA of content, raising throughput without sacrificing quality.

Incorporate feedback from testers, learners, and reviewers into content revisions, and use learner outcome data to improve course effectiveness.

In this role, you’ll work in a curriculum pod and report into a Technical Curriculum Lead. This position is US remote.

What’s In It for You?

You’ll build data science learning that reaches people at enterprise scale and gives them skills they can apply on the job.

You’ll work at the leading edge of AI-accelerated content development, helping shape the tooling and workflows the pipeline depends on.

Accenture will continually invest in your craft and growth, with access to certifications, learning resources, and a global community of practitioners.

You’ll collaborate with subject matter experts, authors, and testers across the Accenture LearnVantage team.

Travel may be required for role. 0-80% depending on client and business needs.

Here’s What You Need:

Minimum 3 years of professional experience in data science or data analytics, including data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, data visualization, statistical modeling, and machine learning, using Python (including NumPy, pandas, and scikit-learn) and SQL.

Minimum 3 years of experience in instructional design, curriculum development, or teaching technical content to adult learners, grounded in adult learning science (scaffolding, retrieval practice, cognitive load, and assessment).

Minimum 3 years of experience with AI tooling for drafting, iteration, and QA.

Minimum 1 year of experience with version control tools like Git.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).

Bonus Points If:

You have experience authoring and testing hands-on labs or projects end to end, including container (Docker) and VM environment troubleshooting.

You have experience building dashboards or reporting in Tableau, Power BI, or advanced spreadsheets.

You have experience with cloud-based tools for data workflows such as AWS SageMaker, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, or Databricks.

You have experience with big data tools such as Apache Spark or distributed databases.

You have experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.

You have experience developing asynchronous online course content.
