jobs.title: AI Software Engineer II (Credit)
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

NCC is a leader in providing award-winning software, credit and compliance solutions, and cutting-edge data to the automotive industry for over 30 years. Our solutions help dealerships streamline their operations, enhance their finance and insurance (F&I) processes, and drive profitability. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a high-growth environment.

Overview:

We're seeking an AI Software Engineer II
to help build the next generation of AI-powered capabilities. In this role, you'll develop and deliver production-ready software that integrates large language models (LLMs), machine learning, and cloud-based AI services into customer-facing applications.

You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to rapidly prototype, build, and deploy intelligent features, applying strong software engineering fundamentals to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys solving real-world business problems with modern AI technologies.

What You’ll Do:

Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features within our SaaS platform
Integrate LLMs and cloud AI services into production applications
Develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, and application integrations
Build and maintain data pipelines that support AI workflows
Contribute across the application stack, including backend services and frontend enhancements as needed
Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver customer-centric solutions
Rapidly prototype new AI capabilities and iterate on customer feedback
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code that follows software engineering best practices
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability
Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions

What You’ll Have:

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
2–4 years of professional software engineering experience
Experience developing applications with Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar object-oriented languages
Experience with consuming or integrating LLMs and AI services via APIs
Experience building RESTful APIs and backend application services
Working knowledge of cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience with Git and modern software development practices
Understanding of databases and data modeling (SQL and/or NoSQL)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent collaboration and communication skills

Preferred:

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Experience using vector databases and embeddings
Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex
Experience building data pipelines and AI workflows
Experience deploying containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
Experience developing customer-facing SaaS applications

What Success Looks Like:

Within your first year, you'll contribute production-ready AI features, collaborate effectively across engineering teams, help accelerate AI adoption across our platform, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and reliability of our software solutions.

What We Offer:

Competitive pay
Unrestricted PTO
Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with a company match
Professional development opportunities and continuous training
A supportive, dynamic work environment with opportunities for growth and advancement

We are an equal employment opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Forward Deployed (Copilot and Azure AI Foundry)
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The AI Engineer is a hands-on builder who works directly with Client teams to design, build, and ship production AI solutions on Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Foundry (now Microsoft Foundry). This is an individual contributor role. You will write the code, configure the agents, wire up the data, and get solutions into the hands of real users.

You will work inside a Collectiv delivery team alongside a project lead, architects, and data engineers. You will partner directly with Client business and IT stakeholders to turn a business problem into a working AI solution, then harden it for production.

Key Responsibilities

Copilot Solutions

Build declarative agents, Copilot connectors, and plugins that extend Microsoft 365 Copilot with Client data and workflows
Build Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, and autonomous agents for business processes
Connect Copilot to SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, and line-of-business systems
Write and iterate on prompts, instructions, and agent configurations based on test results and user feedback

Azure AI Foundry Solutions

Build custom agents and AI applications in Azure AI Foundry for use cases that go beyond out-of-the-box Copilot
Select, deploy, and configure models from the Foundry model catalog, and explain the trade-offs in cost, quality, and latency
Implement agentic workflows with tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems through APIs, Azure Functions, Power Automate, and Logic Apps

Retrieval and Data Foundations

Build end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines including ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, and grounding
Use Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence to index and extract knowledge from Client content
Partner with Collectiv data engineers to connect AI solutions to Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and other enterprise data platforms

Evaluation and Production Readiness

Build evaluation sets and test harnesses that measure answer quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, safety, latency, and cost
Implement logging, monitoring, and tracing for deployed agents and models
Apply security, identity, and governance controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, and Azure AI Content Safety
Use version control, CI/CD, and code review standards for all AI solution code and configuration

Consulting and Collaboration

Work directly with Client stakeholders to gather requirements, run working sessions, demo progress, and manage expectations
Translate business problems into scoped, buildable AI use cases with clear success metrics
Train Client users and administrators on the solutions you build and support adoption after go-live
Contribute reusable patterns, accelerators, and documentation to Collectiv's AI practice

Eligibility for this engagement

This engagement requires US citizenship under the client's contract terms. This is a condition of the specific client project, not a Collectiv policy; Collectiv regularly hires non-US citizens and people based outside the US for other roles.
You must be physically located in the United States for the duration of the engagement.
If you do not meet these two conditions, please still apply: we will keep your application active for AI Engineer roles that do not carry this requirement and contact you directly when one opens.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or Microsoft 365 and Power Platform development
1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying generative AI or LLM-powered solutions in production or Client environments
Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility and Copilot Studio
Hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI
Experience building RAG solutions with Azure AI Search
Strong Python or C# skills
Experience working in Azure (storage, compute, identity, networking)
Ability to work independently in a Client-facing consulting role

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen
Experience with Power Platform, Dataverse, and Power Automate
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Power BI
Experience with LLMOps practices including evaluation frameworks, prompt management, and model monitoring
Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for AI in regulated industries
Consulting experience across multiple Clients or industries
Relevant certifications such as Azure AI Engineer Associate, Copilot Studio or Power Platform certifications, or Fabric (DP-600, DP-700)

What Success Looks Like In This Role

AI solutions you build reach production and are used by real people, not just demoed
Clients trust you as the engineer who knows how to make Copilot and Foundry work in their environment
Your solutions are measured, documented, secure, and supportable after handoff
You contribute patterns and accelerators that make Collectiv's next AI engagement faster

Why Collectiv

Join Collectiv for a rewarding career in a fully remote work environment with quarterly in-person team Experiences and competitive compensation. We provide a clear growth trajectory with professional development opportunities and a top-shelf benefits package. Enjoy unlimited time off and 100% covered health insurance, encompassing medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. Our comprehensive offerings, from a competitive 401(k) with a 4% match to educational assistance, tech stipend, and discounts on various goods and services, demonstrate our commitment to your well-being and success.

Collectiv is the leading boutique consulting and strategy firm specializing in Analytics, Planning, and AI with Power BI and the Microsoft data stack.

Our mission at Collectiv is simple: We help enterprises break free from stagnation and make better decisions.

Our Core Values

Growth Mindset: Bring solutions, not problems.
Excel with Humility: Be humbly brilliant.
Communicate Actively and Empathetically: Listen, ask, understand, help.
Work Hard, Play Hard: Results are proportional to effort.
Keep Calm and Carry On: Stay cool, calm, and Collectiv.

jobs.description:
About the Job

This role is for one of our client companies — an early-stage, seed-backed AI startup building AI-native solutions for enterprises.

Salary:
$170K–$220K
Location:
Remote - US
Experience:
3+ years of professional experience after your last degree
Time Zone:
EST time zone preference
Apply once and, if selected, get access to up to 20 remote and onsite interview opportunities.

What We’re Building

CodeRound AI matches the top 5% tech talent with the fastest-growing, VC-funded AI startups across Silicon Valley and India.

Top-tier product startups across the US, UK, EU, UAE, and India have hired top engineers through CodeRound.

Forward Deployed Engineer (3+ Years of Experience)

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work closely with customers and the product/engineering team to build and deploy solutions for complex, real-world business problems. This is an opportunity for engineers who enjoy combining strong technical execution with customer-facing problem solving and high ownership.

You'll work across product, engineering, and customer environments to understand challenges, build tailored solutions, and help turn those solutions into scalable product capabilities.

What You'll Do

Work directly with customers to understand complex technical and business requirements.
Build and deploy production-grade solutions tailored to customer workflows.
Develop integrations, automations, APIs, and product capabilities to solve customer problems.
Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to translate customer feedback into scalable features.
Debug technical issues and drive solutions from problem discovery through production deployment.
Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions in a fast-paced environment.
Identify recurring customer needs and help turn them into reusable product capabilities.
Take end-to-end ownership of projects while balancing customer needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.

You're a Great Fit If You

Have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience after your last degree.
Have strong software engineering and problem-solving fundamentals.
Enjoy working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into technical solutions.
Are comfortable building, debugging, and deploying production systems.
Can work effectively across product, engineering, and customer-facing teams.
Thrive in fast-paced startup environments with high ownership and ambiguity.
Demonstrate strong communication and technical judgment.
Can independently take a problem from discovery to production.

Bonus Points If You Have

Experience in a Forward Deployed, Solutions Engineering, or customer-facing engineering role.

for an innovative, AI-driven technology company in New York City.

You will develop, deploy, and continuously improve software solutions using real customer data while helping drive product adoption and operational efficiency.

Work directly with accounting teams to understand bookkeeping, reconciliation, and month-end closing workflows.

Develop and deploy AI agents and workflow automation tools to improve accounting operations.
Monitor product adoption, identify workflow issues, and continuously improve deployed solutions.
Build reusable software components and scalable automation systems for future deployments.
Collaborate with Deployment Strategists, engineers, and accounting professionals to deliver reliable solutions.

1–4 years of experience in Software Engineering, Backend Engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with complex, real-world business workflows.

Comfortable working directly with customers and taking ownership of projects from development through deployment.

Experience with browser automation and workflow automation tools.

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Founded in 2020, Regal is the AI Agent Platform. Regal gives every company the tools to transform customer communications with delightful AI Agents that are connected to your data, easy to customize and monitor, always-available, and ready to take action. Power better support, sales and operations – with way less effort. Our founders, Alex Levin and Rebecca Greene helped build Angi (Angie’s List, HomeAdvisor and Handy) to over $1.5B in revenue.

Based in Manhattan, we’re building an in-person culture of entrepreneurs who want to win and build something meaningful. We’re backed by top investors including Founder Collective, Homebrew and Emergence Capital.

Come join us as we create a category-defining company, and follow Regal's company page on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our journey and current job openings!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Forward Deployed Engineer at Regal you’re the product owner of each customer’s onboarding journey. Imagine taking the reins of a micro “product launch” for every new customer. You’ll be responsible for bringing our Voice AI Agents to life in production.

This role is for someone who doesn’t know the meaning of “not my problem.” You take end-to-end ownership, step into ambiguity, and do what it takes to move customers forward. It’s a unique opportunity to work with founders at the forefront of AI innovation and define the next generation of customer experiences.

If you love operating at the intersection of technical execution and product strategy—turning business objectives into real product experiences and approaching each deployment like a tightly scoped MVP—this role was built for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Accelerate Customer Deployments: Execute end-to-end deployments by treating onboarding as a mini product cycle, integrating AI Agents seamlessly into customer systems and workflows to move the needle on key business metrics
Own the Product Vision (Per Deployment): Collaborate with customers to understand their goals, success criteria, and operational context. Then, translate these insights into a clear, measurable deployment plan that aligns Regal’s capabilities with their strategic objectives
Architect Technical Integrations: Work hands-on with APIs, webhooks, and databases to seamlessly integrate Regal into the customer’s existing systems
Shape Conversational Experiences: Work internally with Regal AI Product Specialists to guide the creation and refinement of voice prompts and AI agent settings to achieve the conversational quality that is Regal’s signature
Measure, iterate, and adapt: Build reporting to measure AI Agent performance, partner with customers to refine post-call analysis, and create a roadmap of A/B tests to continuously improve accuracy and outcomes
Stakeholder Management: Provide weekly status updates, manage timelines, and communicate proactively with both internal and external stakeholders. Mitigate risks, reprioritize as needed, and keep everyone aligned around the deployment roadmap
Unlock Future Value: As customers gain confidence, surface new use cases and features that can drive ongoing value. Use your product and commercial mindset to spot expansion opportunities and ensure each deployment isn’t just a one-off success, but the start of a long-term partnership

ABOUT YOU:

Technical Chops: 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Implementation Consultant or a PM in a tech environment). Comfort working with APIs, writing a bit of middleware code when needed, and framing product capabilities for executive stakeholders
Strategic Problem-Solving: You look beyond the immediate ask, synthesizing business needs, user experience, and platform constraints into a cohesive product vision—and executing on it
Outstanding Communication: Whether you’re writing a project brief, presenting call flow diagrams, or explaining data integration steps to a CTO, you tailor your message and ensure everyone understands the big picture
Relentless Ownership: “Not my problem” isn’t in your vocabulary. You’re accountable for the success of each deployment, making smart trade-offs, iterating quickly, and doing whatever it takes to ship on time
Curiosity for AI & Voice: You’re excited about the potential of Voice AI. Maybe you’ve dabbled in conversational design, prompt engineering, or user research for voice interfaces. You’re eager to learn more and push the envelope on what’s possible
Entrepreneurial DNA: You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where you can shape processes, influence product direction, and drive revenue. Your adaptability and growth mindset help you navigate change and complexity with ease.
Ability to travel: You should expect to travel 1 week per month. When launching a new customer, you’ll travel to their office (if they are in person), and periodically thereafter to meet with execs

BENEFITS/PERKS:

We care about your health!
Medical, Dental, and Vision plans - 80% covered by the company
Flexible PTO & 11 paid holidays/year
Subsidized ClassPass membership
We care about future you!
401k Plan
Paid parental leave
Pre-tax commuter benefits
We care about connection!
In-office breakfast and snacks daily
Happy hours, team outings, & annual off-sites
Complete laptop workstation
& more to come!

POSITION LOCATION & OFFICE DETAILS:

This position is only available in New York City (HQ- NoMad). Hybrid roles are required in office T/W/TH and encouraged 5x/week.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

All offers include a competitive equity package and some offers may additionally include a variable compensation component. Actual compensation is determined on an individualized basis taking into consideration factors such as the candidate's skills, location, qualifications, experience, and relevant education or training. In addition, Regal offers a comprehensive set of employee benefits which are listed above. Details about the compensation package will be finalized at the time of offer.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, AI Software
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Solutions Architect to join our OEM team and help enterprise customers build solutions with our newest AI software. You will be a trusted technical advisor to our OEM partners and their customers, turning the NVIDIA AI software stack into validated, deployable solutions for generative AI and large language models. You will architect AI applications, build proof-of-concepts, and work hands-on with the models, inference services, and pipelines that take enterprise AI into production. Would you like to join us at the forefront of enterprise AI?

What You Will Be Doing

Partner with NVIDIA’s OEM partners to define, validate, and document enterprise AI solutions built on the NVIDIA AI software stack.
Architect and deliver customer proof-of-concepts and custom demos that show generative AI solving critical business problems, from RAG-based assistants to fine-tuned models.
Act as the OEM team’s technical authority on NVIDIA AI software, troubleshooting deployments from CUDA and container runtimes through model serving and distributed inference.
Enable OEM and channel technologists on joint NVIDIA and OEM AI solutions through training, workshops, and sessions at industry events.
Bring field insight from customer deployments back to NVIDIA product and engineering teams to shape future releases.

What We Need To See

8+ years as a solutions architect, software engineer, or in a technical presales role, and a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Proven experience designing and deploying production AI software for enterprise customers, including model serving, MLOps pipelines, and Kubernetes-based orchestration.
Hands-on experience building and deploying generative AI applications, including LLM inference, fine-tuning, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Strong Python programming skills for building AI applications, APIs, and automation.
Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-experts.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience with NVIDIA AI software, such as NVIDIA NIM, NVIDIA NeMo Framework, Nemotron models, Dynamo, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, TensorRT-LLM
Experience developing validated AI solution designs with an OEM or system integrator.
Experience with MLOps and AI workload orchestration platforms, such as NVIDIA Run:ai.
Experience benchmarking and optimizing AI inference performance, such as MLPerf Inference.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you are creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

183,750 USD – 351,000 USD for Level 4; and 225,000 USD – 429,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 20, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description:
Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane
, and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane
—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable
.

Our mission
is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents
. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies
and platform engineers across 100+ countries
. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads
and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide
. We’re a Series B
company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital
, and we’ve raised $69M
to date. Learn more at upbound.io
.

As a Staff Solutions Architect at Upbound, you own the technical success of our customers. You are the primary driver of customer outcomes, from initial implementation through production adoption, ensuring customers achieve real business value with Crossplane and the Upbound platform. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role embedded in the post-sales motion
, working closely with customers to deliver working solutions, not just guidance.

In This Role, You Will Own

Customer Technical Outcomes

Drive end-to-end technical success for a portfolio of enterprise customers, from post-sales handoff through production adoption.
Own the implementation of known Upbound use cases — control plane architectures, Upbound/Crossplane configurations, GitOps integration, platform engineering patterns — and ensure customers reach their target state.
Define and track technical milestones that map to customer business objectives and contract value.
Act as the primary technical escalation point when customers face blockers, coordinating engineering and product resources to resolve them.

Implementation & Architecture

Lead technical discovery to deeply understand customer environments, platform requirements, and target architecture.
Design and deliver Crossplane-based control plane architectures tailored to customer infrastructure and organizational context.
Build and maintain reference platforms and implementation accelerators that codify Upbound best practices and reduce time-to-value for common use cases.
Contribute Statements of Work that accurately scope implementation engagements.
Write code, fix bugs, and build scoped features within Upbound products, provider ecosystem, and Crossplane core where needed to unblock customers.

Technical Voice of the Customer

Represent customer technical needs internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
Partner with pre-sales SEs to ensure smooth, informed handoffs with full context on customer environment and expectations.
Identify expansion opportunities as customer technical maturity grows and new Upbound capabilities become relevant.

You Are a Good Fit If You Have

Hands-on Kubernetes expertise — operators, controllers, or add-ons; production deployment and management experience.
Platform engineering or SRE background, with direct experience building or operating an Internal Developer Platform (IDP).
Deep familiarity with cloud-native tooling: CNCF ecosystem, IaC (Terraform/Pulumi), GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines.
Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) at production scale.
Strong programming skills; Go is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of leading customers through complex technical implementations to successful, measurable outcomes.
Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting architecture and trade-offs to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
Able to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-moving startup environment.

It Is a Plus If

Crossplane power user — contributions to core or the provider ecosystem are very appreciated [for many reasons]
Active Kubernetes community involvement: contributions, conference talks, technical writing, or open source maintainership.
CKA or CKAD certification.
Prior startup, familiarity with coding agents and distributed team experience.

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable
.

is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents
. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies
and platform engineers across 100+ countries
. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads
and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide
. We’re a Series B
company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital
, and we’ve raised $69M
to date. Learn more at upbound.io
.

As a Staff Solutions Architect at Upbound, you own the technical success of our customers. You are the primary driver of customer outcomes, from initial implementation through production adoption, ensuring customers achieve real business value with Crossplane and the Upbound platform. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role embedded in the post-sales motion
, working closely with customers to deliver working solutions, not just guidance.

In This Role, You Will Own

Customer Technical Outcomes

Drive end-to-end technical success for a portfolio of enterprise customers, from post-sales handoff through production adoption.
Own the implementation of known Upbound use cases — control plane architectures, Upbound/Crossplane configurations, GitOps integration, platform engineering patterns — and ensure customers reach their target state.
Define and track technical milestones that map to customer business objectives and contract value.
Act as the primary technical escalation point when customers face blockers, coordinating engineering and product resources to resolve them.

Implementation & Architecture

Lead technical discovery to deeply understand customer environments, platform requirements, and target architecture.
Design and deliver Crossplane-based control plane architectures tailored to customer infrastructure and organizational context.
Build and maintain reference platforms and implementation accelerators that codify Upbound best practices and reduce time-to-value for common use cases.
Contribute Statements of Work that accurately scope implementation engagements.
Write code, fix bugs, and build scoped features within Upbound products, provider ecosystem, and Crossplane core where needed to unblock customers.

Technical Voice of the Customer

Represent customer technical needs internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
Partner with pre-sales SEs to ensure smooth, informed handoffs with full context on customer environment and expectations.
Identify expansion opportunities as customer technical maturity grows and new Upbound capabilities become relevant.

You Are a Good Fit If You Have

Hands-on Kubernetes expertise — operators, controllers, or add-ons; production deployment and management experience.
Platform engineering or SRE background, with direct experience building or operating an Internal Developer Platform (IDP).
Deep familiarity with cloud-native tooling: CNCF ecosystem, IaC (Terraform/Pulumi), GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines.
Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) at production scale.
Strong programming skills; Go is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of leading customers through complex technical implementations to successful, measurable outcomes.

Able to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-moving startup environment.

Crossplane power user — contributions to core or the provider ecosystem are very appreciated [for many reasons]
Active Kubernetes community involvement: contributions, conference talks, technical writing, or open source maintainership.

Prior startup, familiarity with coding agents and distributed team experience.

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Us

The AI Transformation Team, part of the Applied AI Strategic Growth Market (AAI SGM), is dedicated to accelerating the adoption and delivery of agentic AI solutions within Deloitte. Recruiting for this role ends on 12/04/2026.

Role Description:

The Applied AI SGM AI Transformation Team is seeking a Applied AI Software Engineer III to join our intake solutioning team for top-prioritized agentic AI solutions in our Enterprise Solutions.

You will support the end-to-end process for agentic AI solutions: use case intake, solution feasibility assessment, solution design, requirements gathering, technology and tooling selection, and initial prototyping. You will also serve as the link between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring clear handoffs and robust solution foundations. This role requires a blend of traditional software engineering skills, cloud solution architecture experience, and hands-on expertise with generative AI models and agentic frameworks.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree required
5+ years of applicable experience
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python and Git, grounded in core software engineering practice including modular design, API design, testing, code review, and CI/CD.
Cloud Solution Architecture: Experience designing and deploying solutions on Azure, GCP, or AWS, including the security, integration, and cost considerations that shape design.
Design Trade-offs and Technical Judgment: Ability to translate business objectives into technical options, and to explain the effort, risk, and value of each in terms stakeholders can act on, driving decisions on scope, sequencing, and architecture.
Generative AI APIs: Hands-on experience integrating and orchestrating solutions using APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers.
AI Tool Experience: Hands-on experience with AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, ideally including code generation work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.
Agentic Frameworks: Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Vertex AI Agent Development Kit, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
Solution Evaluation: Ability to assess build vs. buy decisions, evaluate risk, data requirements, ROI, and timelines.
Stakeholder Collaboration and Design Trade-offs: Experience working with business and technical stakeholders to prioritize and align solution opportunities, translating business objectives into technical options and explaining the effort, risk, and value of each in terms stakeholders can act on.
Project and Team Leadership: Experience scoping and sequencing delivery work, managing timelines across concurrent intakes, coordinating handoffs with development teams, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
Responsible AI and Risk: Familiarity with data privacy, confidentiality, and auditability requirements for enterprise AI, human-in-the-loop design, and agent-specific risks such as prompt injection and tool permission scope.
Agent Interoperability (preferred): Exposure to emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) for connecting agents to enterprise tools, data sources, and other agents.
Full Solution Lifecycle (preferred): Experience taking solutions from intake through prototyping to deployment and adoption.
Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Location: Hybrid(New Orleans, LA or Houston, TX)

Duration: Full time/Long-term

We are seeking an experienced Cloud Platform Engineer to lead AI/ML platform engineering across AWS Bedrock and CoPilot (Azure) environments, drive cloud platform ownership using DevOps and Agile practices, and build scalable solutions supporting analytics, automation, and Generative AI capabilities for internal teams.

Define and execute a multi-cloud roadmap aligning AWS and Azure capabilities with enterprise business goals and technical requirements.

Working knowledge across core technology domains, including infrastructure, applications, software development, end-user platforms, and IT operations.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, AI & ML, Penguin Random House (Open to Remote)
jobs.description:
Penguin Random House LLC

New York, 1745 Broadway, United States

remote

USD 185,000 - 210,000 (Yearly)

Company Description

Penguin Random House is the leading adult and children's publishing house in North America, the United Kingdom and many other regions around the world. In publishing the best books in every genre and subject for all ages, we are committed to quality, excellence in execution, and innovation throughout the entire publishing process: editorial, design, marketing, publicity, sales, production, and distribution. Our vibrant and diverse international community of nearly 300 publishing brands and imprints include Ballantine Bantam Dell, Berkley, Clarkson Potter, Crown, DK, Doubleday, Dutton, Grosset & Dunlap, Little Golden Books, Knopf, Modern Library, Pantheon, Penguin Books, Penguin Press, Penguin Random House Audio, Penguin Young Readers, Portfolio, Puffin, Putnam, Random House, Random House Children's Books, Riverhead, Ten Speed Press, Viking, and Vintage, among others. More information can be found at http://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/.

Penguin Random House values the array of talents and perspectives that a diverse workforce brings. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Job Description

The Data Science team at Penguin Random House builds recommendation systems, forecasting models, and AI-powered tools that shape how readers discover books across our platforms. Our team of scientists and engineers develops and operates these systems end-to-end, from research through production.

We are building a dedicated cloud environment on AWS, along with ML platforms that enable our scientists to deliver models to production quickly. We are hiring a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to build and maintain the foundational systems that support this work.

You will build on a mature MLOps foundation and work closely with AI to evolve and run our cloud platform.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and own core components of our AWS environment used across data science products. Set the standards for how people and AI agents change infrastructure: review, tests and guardrails.
Build self-service paths to production for scientists: CI/CD pipelines, promotion gates, and automated triggers, so scientists can ship models without hand-holding.
Help maintain the security, compliance, and reliability of cloud environments.
Shape the platform roadmap by identifying the infrastructure work that will most unblock our scientists, and keep stakeholders informed as it progresses.

Qualifications

5+ years building and running production systems.
Track record of designing infrastructure components or tooling that other engineers or teams adopted.
Hands-on cloud experience (AWS preferred).
You can use AI agents to build and operate systems, and you can show work you shipped this way.
Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with data scientists and engineers.
Experience running infrastructure for ML or data-intensive workloads in production, such as model training, batch scoring or model serving.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience defining SLOs or SLAs and managing cloud cost for ML production systems.
Experience with evaluation or error analysis of ML or LLM systems in production.

Additional Information

The salary range for this position is $185,000-$210,000.
All positions are currently eligible for an annual profit award or bonus, subject to Company results.

Applications for this role will be accepted through December 3, 2026, or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we review applications on a rolling basis. For this position a complete application should include your resume and cover letter, as both are required for consideration. new_jobs.title: Founding AI Robotics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Base Comp:
 $220k - $520k

Total Comp:
 $360k up to $3.4M+ for exceptional performance (with major milestone bonuses up to $3.4M+ for achieving SOTA contact-rich manipulation and other SOTA robotics targets)

The Opportunity

Newtson Industries is hiring a Founding AI Robotics Engineer to work alongside Inventor & CEO Dylan Gastel, our Founding AI Researcher, and our Founding Robotics Hardware and Mechatronics Engineers to build and train the intelligence brain behind Newtson's robotics team. Our ambition is to build the best robot in the world, and our overarching technical goal is to achieve SOTA contact-rich dexterous manipulation across real-world physical tasks. As our first short-term proving target on the path to SOTA manipulation, we are sprinting to catch a high-speed football pass from an NFL quarterback better than any wide receiver and better than any other robot in the world before the Super Bowl. Newtson is in the business of inventing technologies that are #1 in the world. You will play a defining role in making history.

How We Operate

Newtson is building a team of S-tier individual contributors who operate as CEOs of their own internal startup, advancing their key initiative within the greater business. We are not seeking senior-level executives who wish to build a large org to manage. We are seeking the hungriest, highest-output individuals who believe their potential is at least 10 times higher than their current compensation structure allows for. If you are the type of person who feels like you can do the work of 10 of your peers, and you wish to be compensated accordingly, Newtson is the place for you. If you feel like you have something to prove, we don't care what it is — we will help you prove it.

Qualifications

Newtson Industries is seeking an individual with the following qualifications:

You are fired up to own building and training the brain behind the best robot in the world — with SOTA contact-rich manipulation as the main mission and our Super Bowl pass-catching milestone as the immediate proving ground.
You understand that your primary contribution is training and deploying real-time perception, prediction, and control policies that push physical robots past current SOTA manipulation limits.
You are a powerful sole contributor eager to collaborate, yet you understand that our success often hinges on your ability to put your head down and just Do Your Job.
You buckle in to grind when needed, and you appreciate that Newtson rewards high output over hard work.
You value the importance of working together, in person, and you will be a strong contributor to team camaraderie, collaboration, and creativity.
You are eager to join a company run like a professional sports team — contribute significantly and you will be significantly rewarded. Mediocrity does not win championships and will be replaced. You are here to win championships.
You bring proven industry experience OR raw, S-tier talent and execution speed across the required job functions — we pay for output, not years on a resume.
You will thrive at a company of Newtson's size — with approximately ten total employees and where you may be the only individual in your department.
You are fearless, yet you take a practical, data-driven approach to risk taking.
You are creative, yet you are comfortable executing repetitive or mundane tasks.
You dream big and frequently voice your ideas, yet you have the humility to know that your ideas will not always prevail.
You usually find the correct answer yourself, yet you have the self-awareness to know when to ask for help.
You are honest, genuine, and care about your individual success and performance, yet you will be selfless and will put the success of the greater entity before that of yourself, knowing that your teammates are doing the same.
You are confident that if chosen for this role, this will be your best career decision.
Your friends, family, and colleagues would overwhelmingly agree with the above statements.

About the Role

You own building, training, and deploying the brain behind Newtson's robots. Your primary goal is achieving SOTA contact-rich manipulation — mastering high-speed, force-sensitive physical interaction on real hardware and scaling those capabilities across American factory floors, with $3.4M+ upside directly tied to hitting SOTA contact-rich manipulation and subsequent SOTA robotics benchmarks. Catching 60 mph NFL passes before the Super Bowl is our short-term target designed to force ultra-low-latency perception, tactile feedback, and dynamic control under real impact loads. You take learning-based and optimal-control policies from simulation and proprietary factory datasets and run them deterministically on hardware under strict 50 to 200 ms budgets.

Required Skills

Robot Brain & SOTA Control

Train and deploy imitation learning, reinforcement learning, VLA, and optimal-control policies directly onto fast, contact-rich multi-axis robots.
Build ultra-low-latency 3D perception, tracking, state estimation, and trajectory prediction pipelines in C++ and Python.
Fuse high-frequency tactile arrays (2,500 Hz), joint encoders, and high-speed vision to solve contact-rich grasping, in-hand manipulation, and dynamic impacts.
Optimize on-robot model inference using CUDA, TensorRT, and C++ to hold hard real-time control loop budgets without jitter.

Work Style

Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO, Founding AI Researcher, Robotics Hardware and Mechatronics Engineers, and Test Quarterback beside the physical robot until reliability approaches 100%.
Own the full loop from simulation and policy training to real-robot deployment without throwing models over a wall.
Combine S-tier research taste for SOTA breakthroughs with pragmatic engineering speed for immediate hardware milestones.

Preferred

Shipped SOTA or near-SOTA real-world policies on dexterous hands, contact-rich manipulators, humanoids, or high-speed dynamic robots.
Deep proficiency in MuJoCo, Isaac Lab, PyTorch, high-speed multi-camera geometry, tactile learning, and real-time Linux.

How to Apply

Send your resume, Google Scholar or GitHub, and 2 to 3 videos of policies or control stacks you personally trained and deployed on real physical robot hardware — along with what broke during sim-to-real transfer and how you solved it.

Email your application to careers@newtson.com.

Newtson Industries is headquartered in San Francisco at the heart of Union St in Cow Hollow. This is an in-person role.

new_jobs.description:
We are:

A leading partner to the world’s major cloud providers, including AWS, Azure, and Google. The formation of Accenture Cloud First, with a $3 billion investment over three years, demonstrates our commitment to deliver greater value to our clients when they need it most and offers huge growth opportunities for you! Our Cloud First group of more than 70,000 cloud professionals delivers a full stack of integrated cloud capabilities across data, edge, integrated infrastructure and applications, deep ecosystem skills, culture of change along with a deep industry expertise to shape, move, build and operate our clients’ businesses in the cloud. To accelerate our customers transformation leveraging cloud, we combine world-class learning and talent development expertise; deep experience in cloud change management; and cloud-ready operating models with a commitment to responsible business by design — with security, data privacy, responsible use of artificial intelligence, sustainability and ethics and compliance built into the fundamental changes Accenture helps companies achieve.

About the Role: Building the Future in the Age of Agents

Join the elite technical and product engine of the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG). We are not a traditional project delivery organization; we are a practice of innovators and builders guiding our clients through the most significant shift in technology: the move to Agentic AI and Product-Led Operating Models. As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Agentic AI Delivery Engineer, you are a new breed of technologist—a "product-minded engineer" who is as fluent in the language of code as you are in the language of customer outcomes. You don't just build solutions; you leverage the best of technologies Google Cloud has to offer for client requirements, helping clients break free from legacy solution mindset and practices to build truly modern, value-driven software products on Google Cloud.

You Are:

A passionate, hands-on GCP specialist/practitioner who understands that great software is not just about elegant code, but about solving real problems leveraging the best technology tools available for a client. You are as comfortable building a multi-agent workflow on Vertex AI as you are testing a solution built by other team members in a compressed timeline, leveraging the various tools and technologies of Google Cloud. You have a consultative mindset and a deep curiosity to understand the "why" behind a client's business requirements and convert them to an optimal technology solution. You are an evangelist for modern ways of working, grounded in the principles of Product-Led engineering and operating models and related approaches. You are an exceptional communicator, great team player, continuous learner and a true believer in continual change.

The Work:

As a GCP Agentic AI Delivery Engineer, you will be a technical and product-centric engineer in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud Agentic solutions for client requirements. You will partner with Accenture's global delivery teams by providing superior technical expertise and product innovation skills. Your role is to execute complex technology solutions for our clients by designing, building, and demonstrating Agentic AI solutions. You will act as a trusted team player, guiding others in the team on how to adopt a Product Engineering mindset and be the expert on specific Google Cloud technologies/products.

Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. Design, build, test and deploy innovative, agentic-first solutions on GCP that are directly tied to the client business requirements.

Hands-On Development & Proof-of-Value: Rapidly design, build, and present compelling proof-of-concept (POC) solutions that bring your Google Cloud proficiency to workable solutions. This includes hands-on software engineering using Vertex AI, Gemini/Agentic AI, BigQuery, Google Data technologies, Terraform, and modern CI/CD practices.

Product-Led Project delivery: Act as an agile SME/coach on modern software development. Guide and enable the delivery team on the principles of the Product Agile Operating Model and how to structure delivery sprints for continuous delivery using Google Cloud Technologies.

Team Collaboration: Ability to travel as needed for project meetings, workshops, client discussions, etc., Working with global teams and leveraging the various collaborative tools and channels for project delivery and status reporting.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).

Minimum of 3 years of experience in a hands-on, client-facing technology role (e.g., Google Cloud Engineer, Product Engineer, Technology Consultant).

Minimum of 3 years of deep, hands-on experience architecting and building solutions on GCP.

Minimum of 2 years of experience interacting with project team members distributed across the globe. Well versed in project management methodologies and product/project testing methodologies.

Minimum of 2 years of proven experience on Google Cloud technologies OR Minimum of 1 years of implementation experience on EITHER Agentic systems, leveraging Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Azure Foundry, Microsoft Co-Pilot and/or AWS Bedrock OR on Agentic systems and Google Gemini Enterprise Partner Specialist certifications (CPS)

Bonus points if you have

Product & Agile Mindset: Hands-on experience working within a Product Operating Model. Practical experience in delivering agile projects, contributing to sprint-based deliverables and outcomes.

Consulting & Innovation Acumen: Experience participating in client-facing innovation workshops and converting ideas into outcome-focused solutions. World-class communication skills to articulate project status and delivery challenges and issues to project leadership and client audiences.

Agentic AI & Software Product Engineering: Proven experience architecting and building agentic workflows using Vertex AI. Deep understanding of agentic components, including reasoning engines, planning, tool use, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Hands-on expertise with Google's Gemini models. A commitment to software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and building secure, scalable products.

Technical Depth: Google Cloud Professional certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Data Engineer, GenAI Leader). Project experience across the GCP ecosystem, including GKE, BigQuery, Vertex AI, CES, Apigee, and other GCP technologies.

new_jobs.title: Senior Principal AI/ML Developer
new_jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100188

This role can be remote within the U.S. or Canada, though San Francisco is the preferred location

About The Team

At GET (Growth Experience Technology), we fuel sustainable growth by rethinking how customers discover, buy, and use Autodesk. Our focus is creating a seamless, data-driven experience that feels simple, predictable, and tailored to customer needs—while also making it easier and more efficient for our teams to support them. 

To get there, we're building smarter digital experiences, strengthening our platforms, and making our sales and marketing efforts much more efficient and connected. While the product experience will play a key role, a real unlock will come from the technologies that power better customer insights, more personalized engagement, and faster sales cycles. 

What you’ll do

The GET Applied AI organization is looking for a seasoned Senior Manager / Senior Principal of Applied AI Engineering
to lead the application of AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics across Autodesk’s B2C business. This role will play a critical leadership role in shaping how Autodesk uses data and AI to build the eCommerce and personalization platforms of the future.

Applied AI Engineers at Autodesk are both data/research scientists and software engineers, who develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms. Unlike other companies that separate these roles, our Applied AI Engineers work on projects from ideation to implementation.

As a Sr. Principal Applied AI Engineer at Autodesk, you will be responsible for the development and training of cutting-edge machine learning models and algorithms that can effectively leverage our users’ platform activities and industry trends to create personalized recommendations that are delivered to our users at the optimal moment.

As a senior leader within Applied AI, you will set technical and strategic direction, lead a portfolio of high-impact AI/ML initiatives, develop talent, and partner with senior business and technology leaders
to translate Autodesk’s business priorities into scalable AI capabilities.

You will be responsible for advancing machine learning solutions that leverage customer behavior, product engagement, commerce signals, and industry trends to create more relevant and personalized customer experiences. You will also help establish the organizational practices, technical standards, and operating mechanisms needed to scale Applied AI across Autodesk.

Responsibilities

Set the Applied AI Strategy – Define and drive the vision, roadmap, and investment priorities for key data science and machine learning capabilities across Autodesk’s B2C business, including personalization, recommendation systems, segmentation, forecasting, experimentation, churn prediction, product analytics, and customer insights.
Lead a Portfolio of High-Impact Initiatives – Own multiple complex, cross-functional AI/ML programs from strategy through production and business adoption. Establish clear priorities, success metrics, operating rhythms, and accountability to ensure the team delivers measurable customer and business outcomes.
Build and Develop a High-Performing Team – Provide leadership, coaching, and career development for Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers. Create an environment that attracts strong technical talent, raises the bar for execution, and enables individuals to grow in both technical depth and leadership.
Provide Technical Leadership – Establish technical direction and engineering standards for machine learning systems, model development, experimentation, evaluation, production deployment, and MLOps. Guide teams through complex technical decisions while ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Autodesk’s broader technology architecture.
Expand Autodesk’s ML Capabilities – Identify emerging opportunities where AI and machine learning can materially improve the customer experience or business performance. Guide the design and development of scalable end-to-end ML platforms and pipelines that enable personalization and intelligent decision-making at scale.
Drive Experimentation at Scale – Establish robust experimentation and measurement practices that increase development velocity while maintaining scientific rigor. Enable teams to rapidly test hypotheses, evaluate model performance, quantify incremental impact, and translate learnings into product and business decisions.
Influence Senior Leadership – Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, and other functions. Frame ambiguous business problems, identify opportunities where AI can create value, recommend investment priorities, and influence strategic decisions through data.
Drive Cross-Functional Execution – Initiate and lead large-scale, complex strategic initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations. Build alignment across technical and business stakeholders, resolve ambiguity and competing priorities, and drive programs through execution and adoption.
Champion a Data- and AI-Driven Culture – Evangelize best practices in applied AI, machine learning, experimentation, and evidence-based decision-making. Help shape Autodesk’s broader approach to responsible, scalable, and business-oriented use of AI.
Translate Technology into Business Impact – Develop compelling narratives that connect data, model performance, customer behavior, and financial outcomes. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences and ensure AI investments are tied to measurable impact.
Raise the Organizational Bar – Establish reusable frameworks, processes, and best practices that improve how Applied AI teams prioritize work, evaluate opportunities, design solutions, and measure results. Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across Data Science, ML Engineering, and adjacent technical organizations.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another related quantitative or technical field.
10+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Research, or a related technical discipline, with significant experience delivering production-scale machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated experience leading teams, technical organizations, or major cross-functional programs, including setting strategy, establishing priorities, and driving execution across multiple simultaneous initiatives.
Experience developing technical talent through coaching, mentorship, technical leadership, performance management, or people management.
Proven ability to lead technical strategy, machine learning system design, and optimization of production-scale ML infrastructure, including model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, monitoring, debugging, and model optimization.
7+ years of experience with software or machine learning system design and architecture, including launching and operating production systems.
Deep hands-on experience with machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, recommendation or personalization systems, and applied statistical methods.
Strong expertise in A/B testing, experimental design, causal reasoning, and measurement.
Strong understanding of statistics, probability, customer and product analytics, and financial or business modeling.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into data and AI strategies and connect technical investments to measurable customer and business impact.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior technical and business leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

MS or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
15+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, or related disciplines, ideally including experience in eCommerce, personalization, growth, digital products, or consumer-facing platforms.
5+ years of experience in technical or people leadership, including building and developing high-performing Data Science and/or Machine Learning Engineering teams.
Experience defining multi-year AI/ML strategies and translating them into organizational roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience hiring, developing, and retaining senior Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and technical leaders.
Experience operating effectively in a matrixed environment and influencing senior executives across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and business organizations.
Hands-on experience with cloud machine learning platforms such as AWS or Azure and strong knowledge of modern MLOps, model governance, observability, and production ML best practices.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, ranking, forecasting, customer lifecycle, or next-best-action systems at significant scale.

new_jobs.title: Founding AI Researcher
new_jobs.description:
Base Comp:
 $210k - $490k

Total Comp:
 $340k up to $3.2M+ for exceptional performance (including milestone bonuses for SOTA physical intelligence and Economic Genome breakthroughs)

The Opportunity

Newtson Industries is hiring a Founding AI Researcher to work alongside Inventor & CEO Dylan Gastel, our Founding AI Robotics Engineer, our Founding Quantitative Researcher, and our Founding Software Engineers, training frontier physical intelligence models on the world's richest proprietary stream of U.S. manufacturing egocentric video, operational telemetry, and high-frequency tactile data. At Newtson, your research directly powers both SOTA contact-rich manipulation and our grand mission of sequencing the genome of the entire U.S. economy — encoding every physical skill, machine interaction, and production workflow in America into foundational AI models. Newtson is in the business of inventing technologies that are #1 in the world. You will be a part of making history.

How We Operate

Newtson is building a team of S-tier individual contributors who operate as CEOs of their own internal startup, advancing their key initiative within the greater business. We are not seeking senior-level executives who wish to build a large org to manage. We are seeking the hungriest, highest-output individuals who believe their potential is at least 10 times higher than their current compensation structure allows for. If you are the type of person who feels like you can do the work of 10 of your peers, and you wish to be compensated accordingly, Newtson is the place for you. If you feel like you have something to prove, we don't care what it is — we will help you prove it.

Qualifications

Newtson Industries is seeking an individual with the following qualifications:

You are fired up by the prospect of achieving SOTA contact-rich dexterous manipulation while helping sequence the complete physical and operational genome of the entire U.S. economy.
You understand that your primary contribution is training foundation models on massive factory datasets that achieve #1 performance in physical manipulation and task understanding.
You are a powerful sole contributor eager to collaborate, yet you understand that our success often hinges on your ability to put your head down and just Do Your Job.
You buckle in to grind when needed, and you appreciate that Newtson rewards high output over hard work.
You value the importance of working together, in person, and you will be a strong contributor to team camaraderie, collaboration, and creativity.
You are eager to join a company run like a professional sports team — contribute significantly and you will be significantly rewarded. Mediocrity does not win championships and will be replaced. You are here to win championships.
You bring proven industry experience OR raw, S-tier talent and execution speed across the required job functions — we pay for output, not years on a resume.
You will thrive at a company of Newtson's size — with approximately ten total employees and where you may be the only individual in your department.
You are fearless, yet you take a practical, data-driven approach to risk taking.
You are creative, yet you are comfortable executing repetitive or mundane tasks.
You dream big and frequently voice your ideas, yet you have the humility to know that your ideas will not always prevail.
You usually find the correct answer yourself, yet you have the self-awareness to know when to ask for help.
You are honest, genuine, and care about your individual success and performance, yet you will be selfless and will put the success of the greater entity before that of yourself, knowing that your teammates are doing the same.
You are confident that if chosen for this role, this will be your best career decision.
Your friends, family, and colleagues would overwhelmingly agree with the above statements.

About the Role

Most AI researchers fight over the same public datasets; at Newtson, you bring S-tier research intuition to a proprietary 50-state industrial data engine capturing how America actually builds things. You turn millions of shop-floor human manipulation trajectories, operational process streams, and 2,500 Hz tactile signals into structured task representations — sequencing the genome of the entire U.S. economy down to atomic skill primitives — and generalizable SOTA robotic policies tested directly on ultra-fast hardware down the hall.

Required Skills

Physical AI Research

Design, pre-train, and post-train large-scale vision-language-action (VLA), world-model, diffusion, or RL architectures for dexterous manipulation and task understanding.
Build self-supervised and multimodal pipelines that decompose raw factory video and telemetry into structured skill primitives across the U.S. economy.
Fuse egocentric PoV video, 3D hand and object pose estimation, kinematics, and high-frequency tactile and force signals into unified models.
Run fast, rigorous scaling and ablation experiments across multi-GPU clusters and validate policy performance on physical robots.

Work Style

Collaborate directly with the CEO, Founding AI Robotics Engineer, Founding Quantitative Researcher, Manufacturing Data Ops Lead, and Multimodal Data QA & Curation Specialist to co-design capture and training loops.
Own the full research cycle from data curation and distributed training code to live robot evaluation without an army of research engineers.
Prioritize empirical physical breakthroughs and data-scaling laws over incremental academic benchmark chasing.

Preferred

First-author publications or flagship model launches in robot learning, multimodal foundation models, video understanding, or embodied AI.
Deep mastery of PyTorch, multi-node distributed training, custom CUDA kernels, and human-to-robot skill transfer.

How to Apply

Send your resume, Google Scholar or GitHub, and a brief note on the most important model or training recipe you personally built — plus what you believe is the biggest bottleneck to SOTA contact-rich manipulation today.

Email your application to careers@newtson.com.

Newtson Industries is headquartered in San Francisco at the heart of Union St in Cow Hollow. This is an in-person role.

About Accenture:

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

We Are:

Accenture LearnVantage helps organizations transform how their people learn and work. We partner with enterprise clients to design and deliver high-quality, scalable, outcome-driven learning that builds the skills their workforces need. Udacity, now part of Accenture LearnVantage, brings deep expertise in technical upskilling through hands-on, project-based online learning. Together we build learning experiences that help people gain in-demand skills in data science, machine learning, AI, and more.

You Are:

You are a technical learning content developer who turns data science expertise into learning experiences that stick. You combine hands-on work in Python, statistics, and machine learning with a grounding in how adults learn, and you judge your own content by whether learners can demonstrably apply the skill in a real-world setting. You own the technical accuracy and instructional quality of what you build, you use AI tooling to work faster without dropping the quality bar, and you collaborate well with subject matter experts, authors, and testers. You are the first person through your own material, so you find the gaps a learner would hit before a learner does. You move toward solutions even when requirements are ambiguous, guided by data but biased toward action.

The Work:

Join the Learning Experience team and help build the data science learning experiences that power effective workforce upskilling at enterprise scale. As a Technical Content Developer, Data Science, you’ll take design requirements and learning objectives from the curriculum roadmap and partner with subject matter experts to build course modules, hands-on labs, projects, and assessments. You’ll own the technical accuracy and instructional quality of what you produce so that learners can demonstrably apply new data science skills on the job.

Develop technical learning experiences (courses, modules, hands-on labs, projects, quizzes, and assessments) against defined design requirements and learning objectives for the data science domain.

Author and test hands-on labs, notebooks, and projects end to end, making sure datasets and coding environments are configured correctly and working solutions are reproducible by every learner.

Build assessments, quizzes, and other instructional-design elements that measure whether the target skill was actually acquired, in line with LearnVantage learning standards.

Validate the technical accuracy of all content, partnering with subject matter experts and authors to keep pace with changes in data science libraries, platforms, and industry practice.

Coach new authors through the course development process and give pedagogical feedback on their content from the learner’s perspective.

Use AI tooling to accelerate drafting, iteration, and QA of content, raising throughput without sacrificing quality.

Incorporate feedback from testers, learners, and reviewers into content revisions, and use learner outcome data to improve course effectiveness.

In this role, you’ll work in a curriculum pod and report into a Technical Curriculum Lead. This position is US remote.

What’s In It for You?

You’ll build data science learning that reaches people at enterprise scale and gives them skills they can apply on the job.

You’ll work at the leading edge of AI-accelerated content development, helping shape the tooling and workflows the pipeline depends on.

Accenture will continually invest in your craft and growth, with access to certifications, learning resources, and a global community of practitioners.

You’ll collaborate with subject matter experts, authors, and testers across the Accenture LearnVantage team.

Travel may be required for role. 0-80% depending on client and business needs.

Here’s What You Need:

Minimum 3 years of professional experience in data science or data analytics, including data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, data visualization, statistical modeling, and machine learning, using Python (including NumPy, pandas, and scikit-learn) and SQL.

Minimum 3 years of experience in instructional design, curriculum development, or teaching technical content to adult learners, grounded in adult learning science (scaffolding, retrieval practice, cognitive load, and assessment).

Minimum 3 years of experience with AI tooling for drafting, iteration, and QA.

Minimum 1 year of experience with version control tools like Git.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).

Bonus Points If:

You have experience authoring and testing hands-on labs or projects end to end, including container (Docker) and VM environment troubleshooting.

You have experience building dashboards or reporting in Tableau, Power BI, or advanced spreadsheets.

You have experience with cloud-based tools for data workflows such as AWS SageMaker, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, or Databricks.

You have experience with big data tools such as Apache Spark or distributed databases.

You have experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.

You have experience developing asynchronous online course content.
